name: Falling Shelves

source.title: Pathfinder Beginner Box: Secrets of the Unlit Star

disable: A hero must succeed at a DC 18 Athletics check or DC 18 Thievery check check to prevent the shelves from collapsing.

items.name: Topple Over
items.text: When a creature attempts to touch the shelves or take anything from them, they collapse, sending debris throughout the room. The trap makes one melee Strike against each creature in the room.
